messages.content:
Outcome: Depressive symptoms (lower is better)

## Study A
Found: benefit
Claim: Higher 25OHD was associated with lower HDRS depression scores after treatment in all patients treated for depression.
Sentence: "We observed a negative correlation between the 25OHD and HDRS score after treatment in all patients treated for depression and in subgroups of women and subjects with recurrent depression."
Measured as: HDRS score after treatment
Population: 99 patients aged 46.9 ± 11 years treated for depression
Intervention: Not applicable (observational; serum 25OHD measured)
Comparator: None (correlation across participants)
Design: case-control study
Sample size: 144
baseline_vitamin_d_status: not_reported

## Study B
Found: no effect
Claim: After adjustment, vitamin D deficiency was not associated with postpartum depressive symptoms in the whole sample; only anxiety symptoms were associated.
Sentence: "After adjustments for confounders, vitamin D deficiency was only associated with increased postpartum anxiety symptoms ( B = 0.17, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 0.03-0.30, p = .017) compared to normal vitamin D levels (≥80 nM)."
Measured as: postpartum depressive symptoms (Center for Epidemiologic Studies-Depression)
Population: Women from the Amsterdam Born Children and their Development cohort (n=2483)
Intervention: Early-pregnancy vitamin D status (deficient ≤29.9 nM) measured at median 13 weeks' gestation
Comparator: Normal vitamin D levels (≥80 nM)
Design: cohort study
Sample size: 2,483
baseline_vitamin_d_status: not_reported

content.text: {"rationale":"Both are observational vitamin D status findings on depressive symptoms, but one is a post-treatment correlation in depressed patients and the other an adjusted cohort of general postpartum women, so the results genuinely differ.","verdict":"genuine","reason":"population","also_differs":["outcome_measure","design_or_bias","comparator"],"detail":"population: patients treated for depression (n=99, HDRS after treatment) vs general postpartum cohort (n=2483, CES-D, early-pregnancy status)"}
